title: 36C3 -  A systematic evaluation of OpenBSD's mitigations
summary: A 36C3 talk that systematically evaluates OpenBSD's exploit mitigations, asking how effective they really are and what they cost in performance, complexity and inspectability. It challenges the project's security marketing.
why: Cited in OpenBSD threads as a skeptical, evidence-based counterpoint to claims about its security, though some dispute its objectivity.

quote.text: the presenter explicitly calls out OpenBSD's tendency to present mitigations without specific examples of CVEs it defeats
